description: Qanat LLM gateway (https://qanat.novin-tools.com): traffic, latency, upstream accounts and proxies, runtime.

panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the gateway's /metrics.
panels.title: Gateway

panels.description: All gateway endpoints, 5-minute rate.
panels.title: Requests / s

panels.description: Share of responses that are not 2xx over 5 minutes. 499 (client closed the request) is excluded.
panels.title: Error share

panels.description: Responses being streamed right now.
panels.title: Active streams

panels.description: Upstream provider accounts marked unhealthy.
panels.title: Unhealthy accounts

panels.description: Proxy → upstream origin pairs whose last health check failed.
panels.title: Unhealthy proxy routes

panels.description: Requests in the selected time range.
panels.title: Requests (range)

panels.description: Input, output and cache tokens in the selected time range.
panels.title: Tokens (range)

panels.description: Time from the upstream call to its first byte, p95 over the selected range.
panels.title: Upstream TTFT p95 (range)

panels.description: Client TTFT minus upstream TTFT. Target is p99 < 10 ms; in production it also includes the time to receive large request bodies. The histogram's top bucket is 250 ms, so values at or above it show as 250 ms.
panels.title: Gateway overhead p99 (range)

panels.description: Failed Redis calls on the hot path. Admission fails open, so these mean quotas weren't enforced.
panels.title: Redis errors (range)

panels.description: Usage events lost because the in-memory buffer was full. Usage and billing would be undercounted.
panels.title: Dropped usage events (range)

panels.description: Request received by the gateway → first byte sent to the client. Network time before the gateway is not included (see the client telemetry runbook).
panels.title: Client TTFT p95 (range)

panels.description: Clients that went away before or during the response.
panels.title: Client disconnects (range)

panels.description: Errors Qanat produced itself: plan, price, unknown model, quota, empty or exhausted pool.
panels.title: Refused by Qanat (range)

panels.description: Share of upstream HTTP answers that were not 2xx (429/5xx fail over; 4xx reach the client).
panels.title: Upstream non-2xx share (range)

panels.description: p50 and p95 of request received → first byte to the client.
panels.title: Client TTFT by model

panels.description: before_response: left while Qanat was connecting upstream. mid_stream: left during streaming.
panels.title: Client disconnects by stage

panels.description: What clients got back, split by who caused it. qanat: refused by the gateway. upstream: non-2xx from the provider (429/5xx were retried on another account first).
panels.title: Errors by source

panels.description: Gateway responses per second.
panels.title: Requests by endpoint and status

panels.description: Requests the gateway refused: quota, rate limit, concurrency, model not allowed, pool exhausted.
panels.title: Rejections by reason

panels.description: Token throughput.
panels.title: Tokens / s by provider and kind

panels.description: Totals over the selected time range.
panels.title: Tokens by provider and kind (range)

panels.description: Open streamed responses, overall and per proxy.
panels.title: Active streams

panels.description: Time from the upstream call to its first byte. Mostly the provider's own latency.
panels.title: Upstream TTFT by provider

panels.description: Client TTFT minus upstream TTFT. The red line is the 10 ms p99 target. In production this includes receiving the request body, so large Claude Code prompts push it up.
panels.title: Gateway overhead by provider

panels.description: Time to open a new connection through each proxy (connections are reused, so this is sparse).
panels.title: Proxy connect time

panels.description: Connect + TLS time of the last health check through each proxy to each upstream origin.
panels.title: Proxy health-check latency by origin

panels.description: 1 = healthy. An account turns unhealthy on auth failures, cooldowns or a failed token refresh.
panels.title: Account health

panels.description: 1 = the last health check reached the origin through the proxy.
panels.title: Proxy route health

panels.description: Failed upstream calls: connect, unauthorized, rate limited, server errors, mid-stream drops.
panels.title: Upstream errors by provider and reason

panels.description: Failures attributed to a proxy: connect or mid-stream.
panels.title: Proxy errors by kind

panels.description: Every upstream HTTP answer, 4xx included.
panels.title: Upstream responses by model and status
